hypothesis_family.name: Yield curve incremental IC at primary horizon
hypothesis_family.description: Two primary experiments: H-20 on DS-EXP-050 and H-20 on DS-EXP-100

correction_rationale: Holm-Bonferroni is less conservative than Bonferroni while still controlling family-wise error rate. With only 2 primary tests, the correction is mild.

secondary_family.name: Yield curve incremental IC at secondary horizons
secondary_family.description: Four secondary experiments: H-5 and H-10 on two universes
secondary_family.role: Robustness only. Does not determine primary success.
